# Washington Department of Revenue

> The Washington Department of Revenue provides comprehensive tax filing, business licensing, and tax credit services for Washington State residents and businesses.

DOR.wa.gov serves as the official portal for Washington State tax administration, business registration, and compliance. The site offers multilingual support in Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Russian, and Vietnamese, and features the My DOR platform for filing taxes and managing business licenses.

## Key Topics

- My DOR portal
- Working Families Tax Credit
- Business licensing
- Tax filing and compliance
- Excise tax
- Sales tax
- Property tax
- Business registration
- Tax credits and incentives
- Voluntary Disclosure Program
- Unclaimed property
- County Board of Equalization
- Language services
- Disaster relief
- Business Licensing Wizard

## Core Services

- [Home](https://dor.wa.gov): Washington Department of Revenue homepage with tax credits and services
- [Open a business](https://dor.wa.gov/open-business): Washington state business licensing requirements and startup guide
- [Manage a business](https://dor.wa.gov/manage-business): Manage Washington business licenses, taxes, and compliance
- [Run a business](https://dor.wa.gov/manage-business/run-business): Renew licenses, file taxes, and manage business operations in WA
- [Grow a business](https://dor.wa.gov/manage-business/grow-business): Business growth resources and tax incentives for Washington
- [About](https://dor.wa.gov/node/505): About Washington Department of Revenue mission and organization

## Business Registration & Licensing

- [Apply for a business license](https://dor.wa.gov/open-business/apply-business-license): Business license application process and registration requirements
- [Plan for taxes](https://dor.wa.gov/open-business/apply-business-license/plan-taxes): Tax planning guide for new Washington businesses and registrations
- [Annual business filers](https://dor.wa.gov/file-pay-taxes/filing-frequencies-due-dates/annual-business-filers): Filing frequencies and due dates for annual business tax filers

## Tax Guidance & Education

- [Laws & rules](https://dor.wa.gov/laws-rules): Washington tax laws, administrative code, and regulations reference
- [My DOR - How to file an Excise Tax Return](https://dor.wa.gov/education/events-workshops/my-dor-how-file-excise-tax-return): Free webinar on filing excise tax returns using My DOR portal

## Language Services & Accessibility

- [Language services](https://dor.wa.gov/language-services): Language services and interpretation options for WA Department of Revenue
- [Información en español](https://dor.wa.gov/es/informacion-en-espanol): Spanish language resources for WA DOR services and tax information
- [语言服务](https://dor.wa.gov/zh-hans/yuyanfuwu): Simplified Chinese language services for WA DOR tax assistance
- [언어 지원 서비스](https://dor.wa.gov/ko/%EC%96%B8%EC%96%B4-%EC%A7%80%EC%9B%90-%EC%84%9C%EB%B9%84%EC%8A%A4): Korean language support services for WA DOR tax and business services
- [Переводческие услуги](https://dor.wa.gov/ru/perevodcheskie-uslugi): Russian language translation services for WA DOR tax assistance
- [Dịch vụ ngôn ngữ](https://dor.wa.gov/vi/dich-vu-ngon-ngu): Vietnamese language services for WA DOR tax and business support

## Support & Contact
